Awesome TTS: A curated path through text-to-speech

name: Awesome TTS
summary: Curated guide to text-to-speech with 185 resources, split between real-time streaming synthesis for agents and offline synthesis for media.
description: A developer-friendly path through text-to-speech organized around one decision: real-time streaming synthesis for agents versus high-fidelity offline synthesis for media. Its 17 sections cover foundational concepts, commercial providers, open-weight models, streaming and cancellation, voice cloning, expressive and multilingual control, architectures, landmark papers, datasets, evaluation and audio codecs.
contains: 17 sections from foundational concepts to codecs
